title: The Restaurant of Lost Recipes by Hishashi Kashiwai
description:
Novels and Nibbles takes us back to Kyoto with the second book in Kashiwai’s series. After enjoying the first book last week, we’re continuing this delicious journey with a search for ramen. Katsuji Onodera wants to taste the ramen he remembered eating as a student. He hopes this particular taste will help him reconnect with his artistic past. His story is another reminder that a bowl of soup can hold more than broth and noodles; it can carry memories of people, places, and moments we long to revisit.

We have decided to give a little extra love to our vegetarian guests and anyone else out there by conjuring up a comforting bowl of noodles! House-made Vegetarian Ramen with rich flavorful broth that brings together savory mushrooms, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and a warming kick (but not overwhelming, just gently warming) of Sriracha and crushed red pepper. This generous ramen bowl is filled with tender noodles and topped with fresh green onions, and a boiled egg.

Stop by and let us serve you a little love and comfort, one spoonful at a time!
